info.title: Matomo Reporting API for Funnels plugin

get.description: Returns summary metrics for a funnel for the requested period.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).

parameters.name: idFunnel
parameters.description: The funnel ID to report, or `false` to resolve the funnel from `$idGoal`.

parameters.name: idGoal
parameters.description: The goal ID to resolve the funnel from, or `false` to use `$idFunnel`. Use `0` for the sales funnel.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

200.description:
Summary metrics for the selected funnel.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns the configured funnel for a goal.

parameters.name: idSite

parameters.name: idGoal
parameters.description: The goal ID to load the funnel for. Use `0` for the sales funnel.

200.description:
The configured funnel definition, or `null` when no funnel has been configured yet.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Deletes the funnel configured for a goal.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to update.

parameters.name: idGoal
parameters.description: The goal ID whose funnel should be deleted. Use `0` for the sales funnel.

get.description: Deletes a non-goal funnel by funnel ID.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to update.

parameters.name: idFunnel
parameters.description: The funnel ID to delete.

get.description: Creates or updates the funnel configuration for a goal.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to update.

parameters.name: idGoal
parameters.description: The goal ID whose funnel should be saved. Use `0` for the sales funnel.

parameters.name: isActivated
parameters.description: Whether the funnel should be active after saving. Truthy values enable funnel reporting.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Funnel step definitions to save. When `$isActivated` is truthy, at least one step is required.

200.description:
The ID of the created or updated funnel.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Creates or updates a funnel that is not tied to a goal.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to update.

parameters.name: idFunnel
parameters.description: The funnel ID to update, or `0` to create a new funnel.

parameters.name: funnelName
parameters.description: The display name to store for the funnel.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Funnel step definitions to save.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional funnel description (max 255 characters).

200.description:
The ID of the created or updated funnel.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns the available pattern match types for funnel steps.

200.description:
Supported funnel pattern types grouped by comparison category.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Tests a value against the provided funnel step patterns.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL or comparable value to test against the step patterns.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Funnel step definitions to test against the input value.

200.description:
The tested value and one result entry for each supported step pattern.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

tags.name: Funnels
tags.description: Exposes the Funnels reporting and management API for funnel analytics configuration. Includes endpoints for funnel reports, funnel definitions, and pattern validation helpers.
